learning_points: Target uptake is one criterion alongside whole-body distribution, disease status, organ function, prior therapy and treatment-specific criteria.
The therapeutic ligand binds the same target distribution and carries a therapeutic radionuclide to expressing tissue.
Dosimetry, blood counts, renal or salivary toxicity, response and radiation-safety advice complete the pathway.
